# RightStart

> Josh Green (RightStart) is a fractional COO/CFO and advisor for nonprofits and mission-driven startups. Clients include aiEDU and Designing Justice + Designing Spaces.

Josh founded RightStart in 2021. Based in San Francisco, working nationwide.

## Services

- Interim/Fractional Executive: Embedded COO or CFO leadership — without the full-time overhead. 10–30 hrs/week · 3–12 month engagements.
- Project-Based Consulting: Scoped help for a specific challenge — compliance, hiring, launch readiness. Defined scope · Typically 1–4 months.
- Advising: Rigorous, honest thought partnership on an ongoing basis via regular calls. 2–4 hrs/month · Ongoing.
- Open Office Hours: Free, no-pitch calls to troubleshoot and think out loud. Free · No commitment.

## Clients (examples)

- aiEDU: interim COO, 2023–2024.
- Designing Justice + Designing Spaces: interim COO/CFO, 2025 to present (current client).
